issue.title: Derive the property-card kit's species lists (240m silent created set, 240q owning kinds and source attributes) from 240f descriptors

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.8 (note #16, F7 from plan:202611/ref_cards.md Follow-ups) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent.

Make the property-card kit's hardcoded species lists derive from the species descriptors in bob-ledger-tools 240f-plugin-property-card-species.js, instead of repeating species names by hand:
- 240m-plugin-property-card-created.js:191, the silent created-stamp set (`temporal || kind === "area" || kind === "notebook" || kind === "prose" || kind === "ref"`);
- 240q-plugin-property-card-frontmatter-ownership.js:547, the owning-kinds array (`["album", "record", "day", "week", "quarter", "year", "bank", "area", "project", "notebook", "prose", "ref"]`), and the per-kind source attribute chain at :536 (`data-ref-source`, `data-intention-source`, ...).
Add descriptor fields (for example `createdSilent`, `ownsFrontmatter`, `sourceAttribute`) and an exhaustive test that every descriptor and every list agree. A new species should then need one descriptor edit.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Ref Cards plan forbade refactoring kit lists while bob-cli-qm was in flight. Both the qm and qp go-lives have now landed, but cabinets (bob-cli-qq, go-live bob-cli-qq.9 still open) edits nearby 240o/240r/240s hunks, so schedule this after qq lands to avoid a collision.

issue.creation_reason: Ref Cards had to hand-add ref to several hardcoded species lists in the kit; follow-up F7 asks to make them descriptor-driven now that the parallel card go-lives have landed.
